Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. ### **Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

Provide enterprise-level operational support for incident, problem, change, request, and event-management activities  

Lead complex and escalated virtualization incidents, including high-risk, recurring, cross-domain, vendor-dependent, and platform-impacting issues  
* Provide technical leadership during P1 incidents by assessing impact, coordinating technical actions, documenting risks and decisions, and driving resolution through closure

* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for virtualization and compute technologies, addressing technical events and requests needing additional resources or urgent attention

Lead or support platform lifecycle activities, including upgrade readiness, compatibility validation, capacity planning, end-of-support and end-of-life assessments, patch planning, firmware coordination, and VCF lifecycle management

* Ensure that clients' infrastructure is healthy, stable, secure, documented, and configured with accepted technical best practices

Perform recurring operational-risk reviews and identify opportunities to improve platform stability, supportability, monitoring coverage, security posture, automation, and service consistency  

Support annual architecture, capacity, lifecycle, and standard-operating-procedure reviews, and provide technical inputs for quarterly business reviews or other strategic client reviews  
Own the technical execution of assigned client onboarding and offboarding activities, including access validation, monitoring coverage, vendor access, initial documentation, known-issue identification, and EoS/EoL review

  + Experience with Nutanix AHV required

  + Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
  Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security
10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems  
10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)  
5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred  
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required

* Operating System skills with Windows and Linux preferred

title: Senior Engineering Manager – Service Transformation & Platform Capabilities
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!


Our Values

**Best Life**


We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**


We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**


From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.


**What You'll Do**

**Lead the service transformation teams**


Build and manage small, high\-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain\-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi\-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans.

**Turn architecture into shipped services**


Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de\-risked, and delivered.

**Establish the base service tier**


Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application — and the AI agents and partners building on top of them — can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably.

**Protect compatibility and business continuity**


Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler\-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual\-running periods, and post\-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved.

**Modernize the application foundations**


Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database\-centric implementations into testable, cloud\-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over.

**Raise the bar for engineering quality**


Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software\-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops — layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience — that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in\-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly.

**Drive AI\-native ways of working**


Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio\-scale transformation.


Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates — not manual inspection — prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio\-scale transformation.

**Hire and grow strong engineers**


Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow\-through.

**Partner across the program**


Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross\-team commitments visible and managed.

**What This Is Not**


This is not an architecture\-only or people\-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes — while your engineers own the code.


This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue\-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long\-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications.


This is not a big\-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events.

**What You Bring**

**Proven engineering leadership**


Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high\-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health.

**Service transformation depth**


Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments — and delivering those migrations to production.

**Credible backend and distributed\-systems fluency**


Enough hands\-on depth — in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems — to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room.

**Migration safety instincts**


You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual\-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs.

**Quality and operational discipline**


You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built — and you hold that bar for your teams.

**People development**


You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care.

**Cross\-functional execution**


You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute.

**An opportunity\-focused approach to AI\-assisted engineering**


You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning — and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective.

**Bonus Points**


Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades.


Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies.


Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well.


Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers.


Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks).


Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day\-to\-day engineering.

**What Success Looks Like**

**The base service tier becomes real**


Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in\-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product\-specific builds behind them are retired — reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered.

**Convergence advances without destabilizing the business**


Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use.

**The platform compounds**


New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well\-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver.

**The team gets stronger**


Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change.

description:
**Position Title:** Client Success Manager


**Reporting Line:** Senior Manager \- Client Success


**Position Purpose:**


The Client Success Manager (CSM) is accountable for the overall health, retention, satisfaction, and growth of an assigned portfolio of clients. Acting as a trusted advisor and executive relationship owner, the CSM develops a deep understanding of each client's business strategy, industry environment, operational processes, and technology landscape to ensure clients realize maximum value from ADP solutions.  

The role is responsible for building strong stakeholder relationships, conducting regular business and service reviews, proactively identifying risks and early indicators of client dissatisfaction, and driving corrective actions before issues impact retention. The CSM serves as the voice of the client within ADP while representing ADP's capabilities, strategy, and product roadmap to clients.

  

  

A key aspect of the role is protecting and growing recurring revenue through effective renewal management, client engagement, and identification of upsell and cross\-sell opportunities that align with client business needs. The CSM is expected to leverage insights into the client's organization, workforce strategy, and technology environment to uncover opportunities for expansion, optimization, and innovation. The role also drives continuous improvement by analyzing service performance, identifying operational inefficiencies, and coordinating actions across both ADP and client teams to improve service quality, business outcomes, and overall client experience.

Client Retention \& Revenue Protection


* Own client retention outcomes and renewal success.
* Identify and mitigate churn risks early.
* Protect recurring revenue and long\-term account value.

Strategic Client Relationship Management


* Build trusted partnerships with executive and operational stakeholders.
* Understand client business goals, industry trends, and strategic priorities.
* Maintain strong stakeholder engagement across the client organization.

Client Value Realization


* Ensure clients achieve desired business outcomes from ADP solutions.
* Drive adoption, optimization, and effective use of products and services.

Service Governance \& Escalation Management

* Drive service improvement plans and accountability across stakeholders.

Growth \& Expansion


* Identify upsell, cross\-sell, and expansion opportunities.
